Here are the steps to do it:
1. Enable USB Debugging on your TV
2. Open this CleanYourTV GitHub on your laptop and make sure it's on the same WiFi:
3. Copy the prompt mentioned here and run it through Claude
If you don't have Claude Pro subscription, you can ask Claude Free to do the same thing. But you will have to manually enter everything and copy the prompts to Terminal/Command Line. This has to be done back and forth for each and every step. But the end result will be the same. This method will work with Gemini, ChatGPT or other AI models too.
